title: Happy shark
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <path d='M37 50 q4 3 0 7' fill='none' stroke='#2f86c4' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
